For over 5 years, Arthur has been professionally covering video games, writing guides and walkthroughs. His passion for video games began at age 10 in 2010 when he first played Gothic , an immersive classic that immediately hooked him on rich storytelling, open-world exploration, and character development. This early experience sparked a lifelong love for RPGs, leading him to dive deep into The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim , where he spent countless hours building characters, exploring vast fantasy worlds, and getting lost in epic narratives.
Over the years, his interests expanded into competitive multiplayer gaming. He has invested significant time in Counter-Strike (both older versions and CS:GO/CS2) for its intense tactical gameplay and Dota 2 for its strategic depth, team coordination, and ever-evolving meta. Gaming remains one of his greatest passions, combining creativity, problem-solving, and community, and it continues to influence his perspective as a guide writer.
In this Roblox game , you crash-land in a huge empty desert with a beat-up old plane and almost nothing else. The whole goal in A Long Flight is to fix the aircraft, scrape together fuel and parts, and keep it in the air long enough to explore farther. Working codes help with that by handing out free Tokens and skins so you can spend less time grinding and more time actually flying.
Tokens are the main currency you use to buy upgrades and extra gear for the plane, which makes longer trips across the desert less risky. A new skin just changes how the aircraft looks, so you can stand out while you search abandoned spots for supplies.
Look on the left side of the screen and click the Codes button.
Type or paste one of the codes into the box.
If a code does not go through, just copy it from the list above and try again.
The devs post new codes in their official Discord server , which is where you can get direct notifications.
We refresh this page whenever new codes for this Roblox game appear, so stopping by every few days is an easy way to stay current without missing anything.
